violations.text: Mozzarella Bread Sticks were received at 122 degrees Fahrenheit; Delivery was at 11 AM to enrolled site. Lunch was to be served at 11:30 and 12:30. Foods were assessed are OK for immediate service. Any hot foods leftover post lunch service will be disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Mozzarella Bread Sticks and GF Chicken Patties were observed held at 94-127 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were reheated during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The coating on the floor in the kitchen area was observed in poor repair. Pitting and build-up of residue was observed during time of inspection.
